uiChanges.overflowContainment: Top up, requirements, Help, and recovery prose use a shrinkable copy column
uiChanges.nativeHeader: native header exposes Connect YNX Wallet and uses the existing YNX handler; web retains the Standard EVM wallet path
uiChanges.locale: Guest core navigation and actions use the existing twelve-locale catalog; Arabic applies RTL text direction
